audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Fiora levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and two items in a lane she wins 44.37% of. Its own whys say the opposite at every row: whys[0] 'neither side owns Level 1 outright', whys[1] 'stun you off the wave before your combo is online', whys[2] 'you take beam plus rocket damage and land no Vital', whys[3] 'resets turrets faster than your Lunges can find a clean path', whys[5] 'you can't clear the turret field without bleeding HP', whys[6] 'zone you out completely'. Packet levelChart: Skill / Heimerdinger x3 / Skill / Heimerdinger x2.
audit.why: Turret is a 1-second cooldown deployable, so the nest reforms faster than Fiora's Q comes back at any rank. Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units against her 400-unit Lunge. Level 6 is genuinely a coin flip rather than hers, because it hinges entirely on whether she parries the grenade — which is what whys[4] describes.
audit.corrected: Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger across both layers, flipped as one atomic group.

audit.why: Four spikes present and honestly ordered — level 1 pre-turret, the 2-3 collapse, the level-6 parry, and the first-item zone. Nothing invented. Added the grenade's flat 11s cooldown so 'bait the grenade' has a clock.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11s at every rank; Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s; UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70s; Turret 1s.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already stated and is correct: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns anyone directly hit, so it is an immobilising effect — Riposte blocking it upgrades Fiora's stab to a stun, which is the one sequence that opens her all-in. Also correct that Micro-Rockets are not worth the parry. Worth noting for the player: the grenade only stuns a direct hit, and merely slows units caught around it, so a parry mistimed against the splash returns nothing but a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names any of Heimerdinger's abilities. That is true of the full layer, which calls everything 'CH-2 Grenade' and 'his turrets' — the content layer does better with H-28G and W rockets but still abbreviates.
audit.why: Riot's names are Hextech Affinity (P), H-28 G Evolution Turret (Q), Hextech Micro-Rockets (W), CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) and UPGRADE!!! (R). Naming them lets the player match advice to the spell they see cast.
audit.corrected: Put the full names of the turret, the rockets and the grenade into the dos and don'ts, with the rocket range and turret cooldown attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR' but its body is the generic Q-lunge trading line, so the itemisation advice the title promises never arrives.
audit.why: Every damage source in Heimerdinger's kit is magic, so magic resist and Mercury's Treads (already the prescribed boot in report[8]) are the whole defensive plan.
audit.corrected: Replaced the body with the actual MR advice keyed to the grenade and rocket poke.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Riposte it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat — Riposte it, then commit.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Heimerdinger, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: His damage is all magic — Mercury's Treads plus a Negatron blunt CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and the rocket poke alike.

edits.before: Heimerdinger wastes CH-2 Grenade (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: H-28 G Evolution Turret redeploys on a 1s cooldown — kill the wave, not the nest.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns a direct hit — sidestep it.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units and his turret beams add up — never trade at range while they are stacked up.

notes: The content layer for this matchup is genuinely good — it names H-28G, the E grenade and the R upgrade, states the Riposte-into-stun sequence correctly, and is honest that Fiora loses the zone war. The full layer was boilerplate with 'CH-2 Grenade' pasted in, and the level chart handed Fiora five of seven stages in a 44.37% lane. One detail the player should eventually get on the page: the grenade only stuns a DIRECT hit and merely slows units in the splash, so a Riposte timed against the edge of the blast returns a slow, not the stun her whole all-in depends on. There was no room to add it inside any existing string's length band.
